clips.title: The story
paras: The Tome of Divinity marks an essential milestone in a dwarven paladin's training within Ironforge. Bestowed by Tiza Battleforge in the Hall of Mysteries, this holy text begins a trials-based journey meant to test an initiate's devotion to the Light and their readiness to defend Azeroth against dark forces like the Scourge.

Paladin mentors across the eastern kingdoms direct promising initiates to Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries once they demonstrate mastery of martial and spiritual fundamentals. Under the watchful eye of Tiza Battleforge, young dwarven paladins are introduced to the solemn principles that separate a simple warrior from an ordained champion of the Holy Light. Taking up this task represents a conscious pledge toward lifelong self-sacrifice, duty, and spiritual discipline.

Accepting this charge places a Book of Divinity into the hands of the novice. This text outlines the expectations, virtues, and spiritual tenets required to wield sacred energies effectively against wicked threats. Studying its teachings is merely the introductory step; the scripture serves as a foundational guide before the initiate is sent forth across Khaz Modan and beyond to embody its lessons in real acts of faith.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A pleasure to meet you, friend. I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
